description.value:
Frequency once per day

Range 30 feet

Saving Throw as the chosen result, or Fortitude if none is stated

Choose one non-permanent result from the Bloom Table (Weeping Wound, Overgrowth, Fever Dream, Feral Twitch, or Blood Hunger) and inflict it on one creature within range as though it had rolled that result on itself, save where the result's own text requires a save. You take no Vitae cost and suffer no Bloom yourself for this use.

cinderfall.incomplete: This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Inflicting a chosen Bloom Table result on another creature as though they'd rolled it combines both absences.
